mcmesh.configuration.packId.tooltip: Modpack this install belongs to; a gateway only shows and accepts worlds of the same pack
mcmesh.configuration.packVersion.tooltip: Version of this modpack, dot-separated integers such as 1.4.0
mcmesh.configuration.packMinHeapMb.toolt: Memory in MB this modpack needs for the game, shipped by the pack author; 0 means no check. Hosting or joining is refused with an explanation when the instance has less.
mcmesh.configuration.packAuthorKey.toolt: Pack author Ed25519 public key (base64url, 32 bytes); empty disables auto-update
mcmesh.configuration.packUpdateUrl.toolt: https URL of the signed pack manifest; the only place updates come from
mcmesh.configuration.packAutoUpdate.tool: set to false to never download pack updates
mcmesh.configuration.channels.tooltip: Extra relay channels as local ports, same order as the gateway MCMESH_CHANNELS, e.g. "24456"
mcmesh.configuration.authMode.tooltip: auto (Mojang then key), mojang, or key
mcmesh.configuration.playerName.tooltip: name to claim on a dedicated server, where there is no launcher session
mcmesh.configuration.shipLogs: Send my log to the gateway operator
mcmesh.configuration.shipLogs.tooltip: send latest.log to the gateway operator once logged in, for debugging, off by default because logs can contain private details
mcmesh.configuration.anchorStandby: Wait as a standby anchor (dedicated server)
mcmesh.configuration.anchorStandby.toolt: dedicated server only: when another machine is hosting the world, wait for it to become free instead of refusing to start (anchor node, restart it with systemd)
mcmesh.configuration.anchorWakeOnJoin.to: anchor only: do not take the world just because it is free, wait until someone tries to play it, and hand it back after anchorIdleMinutes with nobody on. Keeps a modded world from running all night for nobody. Needs a gateway that answers GET /v1/worlds/<id>/demand
mcmesh.configuration.guestWarmSync: Keep a warm copy of the world while I play
mcmesh.configuration.guestWarmSync.toolt: client only, off until tested on real machines: while playing as a guest, keep this machine's copy of the world synced to the newest revision (about every 30 s, incremental), so a takeover of hosting from this machine fetches only the last changes instead of the whole world. Costs bandwidth and disk while playing; the first run downloads the whole world
mcmesh.configuration.contributeWorldgen: Generate terrain for the host when idle
client only, off until tested on real machines: while this machine is not hosting, generate worldgen tiles for a host that asked for them, in a hidden low priority server process started from this game (one tile per process, stopped when you start hosting). Needs the world owner to have turned distributed worldgen on
mcmesh.configuration.workerHeap.tooltip: memory for the hidden worldgen worker, for example 3G
mcmesh.configuration.anchorIdleMinutes.t: anchor with wake on join: minutes with no players before the world is saved and handed back, so the machine goes idle. 0 keeps it up forever
mcmesh.configuration.chatRetentionDays.t: while hosting, keep player chat in logs/mesh-chat (one file per day, on this machine only, never uploaded) for this many days so the owner can read it when a report comes in. 0 keeps nothing and deletes what was kept. Players are not told by the game, say so in your rules
mcmesh.configuration.reportChatLines.too: while hosting, remember the last N chat lines in memory only (never written to disk) so a player can run /meshreport chat <player> <reason> and attach them for the world owner. 0 turns the memory and the command off
mcmesh.configuration.lazyBootstrap: Open worlds before the full download finishes
mcmesh.configuration.lazyBootstrap.toolt: on a full download, start the world once the regions near spawn and the players are on disk and fetch the rest in the background or when the game first needs it. Off by default
mcmesh.configuration.lazyMinChunks.toolt: lazy bootstrap only applies to worlds with at least this many stored chunk entries (region, entities and poi count separately)
mcmesh.configuration.lazyRadiusRegions.t: regions (512 blocks) around spawn and each player that are downloaded before the world opens
a dimension with no spawn or player in it and at most this many entries is downloaded whole before the world opens
mcmesh.configuration.showHostHealth.tool: show a small line in the corner of the screen about how well the host machine is doing
mcmesh.configuration.autosaveSeconds.too: seconds between uploads of the world to the gateway while hosting; a crash loses at most this much play, a smaller number uploads more often
mcmesh.configuration.distributeWorldgen: Let other machines generate terrain for me (host)
Host only: ask the gateway for tiles of unexplored terrain ahead of the players, generated by other members' machines and checked by a second one, and install them before the game opens that region. The world owner must also switch it on for the world, and it only helps once workers run (deploy/worldgen-worker.sh). Off by default
mcmesh.configuration.streamSeconds: Live save interval in seconds (0 = off)
mcmesh.configuration.streamSeconds.toolt: 0 turns streaming off. Otherwise every this many seconds the changes since the last upload are sent to the gateway without making a revision, so a crash or a power cut loses at most this much play; the gateway recovers them from its write-ahead log. Costs a little disk and network on the host
mcmesh.configuration.publicHost.tooltip: address players type to reach the gateway; tickets are attached only when connecting to it
mcmesh.configuration.discordAppId.toolti: Discord application id for rich presence; empty disables it
mcmesh.configuration.modpackUrl.tooltip: direct link to a Prism instance export (.zip); empty hides the modpack updater
mcmesh.configuration.modpackInstance.too: folder name of the Prism instance the modpack is installed into; must differ from the running instance
mcmesh.configuration.gateways.tooltip: Extra join-only gateways as "id=https://api.url"; hosting always uses apiUrl above
mcmesh.configuration.title: Mesh settings
